title: Categorize page follow-ups after budget-mjug: empty bundle entry in the undo stack, counts with pending skips, skip dropped when its row is past the first 200, late response after budget switch, strip layout, toast covering a row
description: From review-mjug-4.md (on budget-mjug), none blocking. 1) Accept bundle on a bundle whose remaining rows are all pending skips pushes an empty '0 transactions' undo entry. 2) Bundle card counts, Accept all count and header still include pending-skip rows. 3) A pending skip whose row falls out of the first 200 loaded rows is dropped silently. 4) A failed response arriving after a budget switch calls refetch on the unmounted hook (unhandled rejection, console only). 5) Z pressed just after a skip's timer fires undoes the action below it. Layout: the strip's Undo sits far from its line; the toast covers a No-suggestion row's payee. Also unverified live: the Run dialog under the key gate, a failed undo, undo above 1000 rows, iOS and narrow widths.
